primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K — Ibsam
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list “Ibsam” section, lines 3304–3308: son of Tola, Chronicles witness; called Jibsam in KJV.
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 英語版人物一覧の「Ibsam」節は、トラの子イブサムを歴代誌上7:2に結び付け、KJVではJibsamと表記されると記します。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 節はWEBのIbsamと割当候補Jibsamの翻訳異表記を明記し、父トラも一致。
